name: WidgetQueryWallet

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Balance of the wallet, in the smallest units of the cryptocurrency, as a decimal number

fields.name: public_key
fields.description: Hex-encoded public key of the wallet; omitted if unknown

fields.name: state_init
fields.description: Base64-encoded serialized StateInit of the wallet contract; omitted if and only if public_key is omitted

description: This object describes a TON wallet of the user, which is used in a query from a widget.
